summary: The acl_manager role (github.com/ansible-security/acl_manager) manages ACLs on many firewall devices, such as blocking or unblocking an IP or URL; a typical incident response runs a playbook with it to block an attacker's IP after an intrusion alert.
questions: How do I block an attacker IP automatically after an alert?
Which role manages firewall ACLs in Ansible security automation?
